en: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David.

zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用吹的樂器。

ja: 指揮者のために。笛に合わせて。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.

ja: けてください。 私の
en: Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.
u.src: 1  Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.

p.src: 2  Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

ja: いてください、私の王、私の神よ。 私はあなたに
en: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.
u.src: 2  Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

p.src: 3  LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

ja: に私はあなたの前に願いを並べ、期待して
en: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
u.src: 3  LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

p.src: 4  For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

ja: はあなたと共に住むことができない。
en: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
u.src: 4  For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

p.src: 5  The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

ja: つことができない。 あなたは
en: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
u.src: 5  The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

p.src: 6  You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

en: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
u.src: 6  You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

p.src: 7  But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

ja: しかし私としては、あなたの
しみのゆえに、私はあなたの
る。 私はあなたを恐れ敬い、あなたの
en: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
u.src: 7  But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

p.src: 8  Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

ja: いてください。 私の顔の前に、あなたの
をまっすぐにしてください。
en: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
u.src: 8  Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

p.src: 9  For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

ja: がないからだ。 彼らの心は破滅である。
en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.
u.src: 9  For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

p.src: 10  Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

ja: らに罪を負わせてください。
れさせてください。 彼らの
en: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.
u.src: 10  Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

p.src: 11  But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

ja: しかし、あなたに避け所を求めるすべての者を
ばせてください。 あなたが
られるので、彼らにいつも
びの叫びを上げさせてください。
する者たちにも、あなたにあって
en: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.
u.src: 11  But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

p.src: 12  For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

ja: あなたは義人を祝福されるからだ。
で囲むように、恵みで彼を囲まれる。
en: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
u.src: 12  For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
